source.title: Super Sema S1E4 · Interactive edit guide
source.section: The interactions and the answers to give

timing.basis: Interaction-table timestamps shifted back by 23 seconds to match the video without the cold opening. Both time and timeSeconds contain the adjusted time.

context.playback: The edit plays one path through the episode.
context.turnIndicator: Spark glows whenever it's the child's turn.

steps.prompt: "Wait, let me ask my friend. What do you think trees do with that air?"
steps.whatFollows: "Yes, you've got it! … A tree is a little air factory!" Then "Hear that? My friend just figured it out…" back to the class

steps.prompt: "Oh no… the trees!" then "My tummy feels all tight… How do you feel, friend?"
"When my tummy's this tight… What helps you when you feel like this, friend?"
steps.whatFollows: "A hug! Good one!…" then one big breath together, "My brain's back!", and "Somebody took our trees. Let's find out who."

steps.prompt: "Look! What is the tree showing us, friend?" (the branches reach towards the castle)
steps.whatFollows: "YES! He can't get out! It's a cage! A prison of trees!" Sema hugs the tree: "Thank you, tree! And thank you, friend!"

steps.prompt: "And we need something that makes trees grow fast!" … "So, what goes into our super-duper plant food? A rock? Old vegetables? Or this sock?"
steps.whatFollows: MB grabs it: "Wait, that's mine! I thought I lost it!" Sema: "Well, MB's happy! But socks don't rot… The rock? Or the old vegetables?"
"Old vegetables! Yes!…" MB: "Root snacks!" Sema: "You knew it, friend! In they go!"

steps.prompt: "Friend, YOU are going to be our remote! Stand up!" MB: "Ready?"
"Make it fly in a big circle! Like this… whoooosh!"
steps.whatFollows: MB: "Signal received!" The drone flies its circle

steps.prompt: "And now the super-duper plant food! Shake it… and RELEASE!"
steps.whatFollows: The plant food sprays, the forest grows: "It's working!"

steps.prompt: "MB, what do you think? Can we trust him?" MB: "Well…" "Everybody makes mistakes sometimes… Friend, your nose is the button. Ready? Three, two, one…"
steps.whatFollows: MB: "Signal received!" Sema: "There go the vines!" The vines let Tobor go

steps.prompt: "Hey, friend… what a day! Remember when you figured out the tree's secret? A cage! And I really liked technovating with you. Technovator high-five?"
